title: Can the construction be made more computationally efficient for large moduli

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: Proved 3 efficiency improvements for non-coprime CRT with large moduli: (1) LCM bound - solutions canonicalize to [0,lcm) saving gcd-factor bits, (2) Bezout reduction on smaller coprime moduli m/g and n/g, (3) Garner mixed-radix decomposition for efficient reconstruction. All proofs compile cleanly in Lean 4 + Mathlib.
builtItems: ChineseRemainderNonCoprimeOQ01.lean - 7 core theorems: gcd_lcm_product, lcm_lt_mul_of_gcd_gt_one, efficiency_ratio, noncoprime_crt_canonical_form, bezout_reduction_coprime, garner_mixed_radix, noncoprime_crt_efficiency_summary
modEq_emod_of_dvd helper: y % L ≡ y [ZMOD m] whenever m | L
insights: LCM bound: solutions to non-coprime CRT live in [0,lcm(m,n)) not [0,m*n), saving log2(gcd) bits
Bezout reduction: coprime reduced moduli m/g, n/g enable O(log(min/g)) Bezout computation
Garner decomposition: x = c1 + c2*m with c1<m, c2<n, arithmetic never exceeds max(m,n)
All three improvements compose: combined saving is factor gcd(m,n) in representation
Extension to 3 moduli: iterated lcm bound lcm(lcm(m1,m2),m3) <= m1*m2*m3 also proved
nlinarith + gcd_mul_lcm identity is the key automation tactic throughout
